extensionName: Universal Logic and Variable Math Pack

newBlocks.tooltip: Allocates slot limits to manage custom items or weapons systems.
Flips an attribute bit inside your item data variables list to collect an item.
Compares a global register tracking value against a target number constraint boundary.
newBlocks.ez80AssemblyTemplate:
ld hl, ({VariableName})
ld de, {GreaterThan}
or a
sbc hl, de
jr z, _ConditionFailed
jr nc, _ConditionFailed

newBlocks.tooltip: Computes quick math addition or subtraction directly on variables scores records.
newBlocks.ez80AssemblyTemplate:
ld hl, ({TargetTracker})
ld de, {AddAmount}
add hl, de
ld ({TargetTracker}), hl

newBlocks.tooltip: Locks a variable number so it can never fall below or exceed absolute screen boundaries.
newBlocks.ez80AssemblyTemplate:
ld hl, ({VariablePointer})
ld de, {MinimumFloor}
or a
sbc hl, de
jr nc, _CeilCheck
ld hl, {MinimumFloor}
_CeilCheck:
ld de, {MaximumCeiling}
or a
sbc hl, de
jr c, _ClampDone
ld hl, {MaximumCeiling}
_ClampDone:
ld ({VariablePointer}), hl

newBlocks.tooltip: Wipes variable logs and scores back to starting points for a fresh reset.
